rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance – coverage (1-4 unit exemption)
rules.requirement: Jersey City's Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260) applies to rental buildings with five or more units. Properties with 1-4 units are exempt from rent control.
rules.requirement_es: La Ordenanza de Control de Alquileres de Jersey City (Capítulo 260) se aplica a edificios de alquiler con cinco o más unidades. Las propiedades de 1 a 4 unidades están exentas del control de alquileres.
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.coverage_conditions: Properties with 5 or more units; the ordinance provides other exemptions that owners may request through the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties; other exemptions available by Rent Control Exemption Request.
rules.caveat: Administrative web page; does not state the rent increase cap or formula, only the coverage exemption and that the ordinance is Chapter 260.
